heroText: Seoul works best as a base in South Korea when you anchor days around Gyeongbokgung Palace, Bukchon Hanok Village and N Seoul Tower. Use those sights to understand the city's history, street life and visitor rhythm. Seoul Incheon handles the main arrival flow, so hotel choice should balance the centre, transfer time and day-trip plans.

stayOverview: Start with Myeongdong for the easiest first Seoul stay, then compare Hongdae and Insadong when price, nightlife, quieter evenings or transfer timing matter more than being beside every major sight.
hotelIntro: Seoul hotel choice is mostly about repeat journeys: use Myeongdong for sightseeing, Hongdae for a different local base, and Insadong or Gangnam when views, parking, airport timing or longer stays matter.
rentalCars: Do not rent a car for central Seoul unless parking and traffic are part of the plan; use one mainly for regional day trips.

history.label: 2nd century
history.text: Baekje (18 B.C. – 660 A.D.), once one of the statelets in the Mahan confederacy, became the dominant local power by the 2nd century A.D.
This area is now in southeastern Seoul. Silla period In July or August 553, Silla took the control of the region from Baekje, and the city became a part of newly established Sin Province.
In 557, Silla abolished Sin Province, and established Bukhansan Province (북한산주; 北漢山州).
In 568, Jinheung Taewang made another royal visit to the northern border, visited Hanseong, and stayed in Namcheon on his way back to the capital.
In 604, Silla abolished Namcheon Province, and reestablished Bukhansan Province in order to strengthen the northern border.

history.label: 11th century
history.text: In the 11th century Goryeo, which succeeded Unified Silla, built a summer palace in Seoul, which was referred to as the "Southern Capital".
After enthroning himself as King at the capital of old Goryeo in 1392, Yi Seong-gye changed the name of his Kingdom from Goryeo to Joseon in 1393 and began his search for a place.
